scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.setup: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run setup -w apps/api && npm run seed
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests docs README.md *.json *.ts *.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests docs README.md *.json *.ts *.yaml
